tagline.en_US: Vivaldi is a Norwegian freeware, cross-platform web browser with a built-in email client developed by Vivaldi Technologies.

description.en_US: Vivaldi is a cross-platform web browser developed by Vivaldi Technologies. It provides an environment for navigating the web, managing tabs, and viewing online media. The application also includes a built-in email client, allowing users to access and organize their messages directly alongside their browsing sessions.
